items.title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
items.content: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.

summaries.zh: OpenAI与Grab联合推出“GO Forward with AI”区域计划，旨在帮助东南亚30,000名合作伙伴提升实用AI技能。该计划将提供相关培训与资源，促进AI技术在区域内的应用与发展。
summaries.en: OpenAI and Grab have launched GO Forward with AI, a regional initiative aimed at equipping 30,000 Southeast Asian partners with practical AI skills. The program focuses on delivering hands-on training and resources to enhance AI capabilities in the region.

items.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
items.content: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.
items.contentSnippet: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.

summaries.zh: GPT-6通过提高缓存命中率、引入新的诊断工具、设置显式断点和控制功能，优化了提示缓存。这些改进有助于降低延迟和成本，提升系统效率。
summaries.en: GPT-6 enhances prompt caching by achieving higher cache hit rates, introducing new diagnostics, enabling explicit breakpoints, and providing controls to reduce latency and costs. These improvements optimize performance and efficiency.

items.title: Priorities and principles for effective third party assessments
items.content: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.

summaries.zh: OpenAI提出了针对前沿模型和防护措施的有效第三方AI安全评估的优先事项和原则，强调评估需严格、安全、独立。
summaries.en: OpenAI outlines key priorities and principles for effective third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models. The focus is on ensuring rigorous, secure, and independent evaluations. The guidelines emphasize the importance of thorough assessments to mitigate risks associated with advanced AI systems. The principles aim to establish a standardized approach for evaluating AI safety, promoting transparency and accountability in the development of frontier models. The goal is to safeguard against potential harms while fostering responsible AI innovation.

items.summary: OpenAI提出了针对前沿模型和防护措施的有效第三方AI安全评估的优先事项和原则，强调评估需严格、安全、独立。
